steps.content: So this is your plan?
You and Bai Yi lie prone in a ventilation duct, which is cramped, stuffy, and really smelly.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Relax. I've done this before all the time, and I've never failed.
Bai Yi's face, close to yours, is the epitome of confidence.
Really?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Wait... Shhh... Blargh...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Phew, that's close.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: ...What were you saying?
Nothing.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Oh, carry on then. We're at the third floor now. Almost there.
You and Bai Yi crawl ahead. As horrendous as it is, crawling inside the ducts, with the enemies milling around beneath you, seems the least worst option.

You have decided against storming this place, because this course of action might be costly and compromise the safety of K.K. and Che. Instead, you have favored a stealthy operation, in which Bai Yi's skills will come in handy if you have to escape in the event the rescue mission fails.
But now, looking at Bai Yi, you can't help but wonder if you have made the wrong decision.

steps.speaker: Guard A
steps.content: Can you smell something funky?

steps.speaker: Guard B
steps.content: ...I think I can. F***! What a bummer. Can you turn on the ventilation?

steps.speaker: Guard A
steps.content: Will do.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Bullshit, I am not smelly.
Bai Yi gets worked up. She brings her face close to yours, trying to prove her point.
You shove her face away. Right at this moment, the ventilation system is turned on. It makes a few strange sounds, and then the age-old ventilation ducts start vibrating.

steps.speaker: Guard B
steps.content: It is me, or is the smell getting stronger?

steps.speaker: Guard A
steps.content: No idea... Just give it a few minutes.
The ventilation system is making a racket, providing an extra cover for your activities. Withstanding the violent vibrations, the two of you move along, now at a much faster pace.
After crawling on all fours for a long distance, you notice Bai Yi has turned pale-faced.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: ...Chief...
What?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I don't want to puke over you, so...
What did you say?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: ...I can't hold it in any longer...
Before you realize what's happening, Bai Yi kicks open the vent and slips out.
Bang! Wham!

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Blargh...
A few seconds later, when you poke your head out of the vent, Bai Yi, looking fresh now, gives you the V-sign.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I'm okay now. Chief, you can come down too.
Okay?! You're standing on a man, and you've barfed all over him.
Wait a second, isn't this the man from the toilet?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Ah? You know this fat man?
I don't know him. He's the one who reported us last time.
You jump down from the vent. Once outside, you look around the room. It's an office, spacious and elegantly decorated.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: He can't be some minion. Look how huge this place is!

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: It's a good thing I knocked him out as soon as I came down.
Yeah, you did the right thing. He is really loud.
What do we do now?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: He looks like a manager or something. Maybe he knows where Che and K.K. are.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I'm not going up there; that's for sure. It's a torture.
You're the one who suggested the ventilation duct...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Haha.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Hey, look at that... The fat man is filthy rich. Even his cardholder is gilded.
Bai Yi changes the subject, picking up a fancy-looking cardholder on the desk.
There may be information about his business partners. Open it.
Bai Yi opens the cardholder, from which she withdraws a deck of business cards. Then she slips the gilded cardholder into her own pocket.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Mr. Jackal... No idea who that is. Tatsuya Usami... sounds like one of Yagyu's people...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Bai Yi?!
She goes through the rest of the cards, all of which are printed with the name Bai Yi.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: So. It's you...
Bai Yi turns around slowly and stares at the unconscious man on the floor with hatred in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: You're the impostor... You're probably the one who captured Che and K.K...
Bam—

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: Ahhh!
Bai Yi doesn't go easy on her impostor, slapping his face hard.
Mr. Bai finally comes around.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Stop whining! Or I'll feed your fat ass to dogs.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: Mmmm... Mmm!
Bai Yi quickly duct-tapes his mouth, and ties him to a chair.
Then she, now wearing a menacing look, produces a short knife and holds it against the neck of her captive.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Speak, where are you keeping my guys?

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: Oooooo...
His mouth is still duct-taped.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Oops, sorry, force of habit from kidnapping.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Cough cough... Mr. Bai, right? I'm gonna ask you a few questions, and I want you to answer them honestly.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I'm not like those two you met earlier. I have a bit of a headache at the moment, and I'm not in a very good mood. If you don't cooperate, don't blame me if I get heated and hurt you by accident.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Also, your men outside, they haven't worked for you long, huh?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: They know we're cops. If they come in and I use you as a human shield, will they open fire? What do you think?

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: Ooo!

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Be a good boy, and don't get any ideas. Understand?

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: Oo.
Bai Yi removes the duct tape on his mouth and sets the chair upright.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: You again? Why do you keep coming for me...
Mr. Bai looks at you, bitterness written all over his face.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: No chit-chat. Where do you keep the guys you captured earlier today?

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: They're in the reception room.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Liar!
Bai Yi kicks him in the shin. The pain sets every ounce of fat on his body shaking, but he doesn't dare to make a sound.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: I-I am telling the truth! Y-you ran away. I was worried about the cops coming to give us trouble, so I didn't dare to lay a finger on them.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: I'm just a businessman; I don't keep a place aside to hold people hostage. The reception room is the only place not occupied most of the time...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: ...Okay.
As you open your eyes, blooming roses fill your sight. Looking at the bright red color all over the place, you're sure you're in a mirage now.
No need to rush. Let me ask him some more questions.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: Ask whatever you want. I'll tell the truth.
Where are you from?

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: Eastside.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: An Eastsider coming to Syndicate for business? You're nuts?

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: My business in Eastside went belly-up... It just so happened some sucker offered me money, and he told me he had some rare products in hand.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: My creditors in Eastside had been on my ass, so I decided to take my chance and come over here.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: A sucker? What's in it for him?

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: No idea. He's very elusive. I haven't even seen his face.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: Oh, he did have one condition. He said the company I was going to establish must be called Whitestone Industries. And that was the only condition.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: I took a precaution though: I did a little research about this Whitestone Industries. Guess what? It's a shell corporation, with only a couple of people.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: People say they had a connection with that Legion. There's a lot of hype. Well, the Legion fell apart not so long ago, and this Whitestone Industries disappeared as well.
So you went ahead and used the name, without a qualm?

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: What do you expect? No one in their right mind would say no to that.
Weren't you afraid of retaliation?

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: Retaliation? They had only a few people. Besides, that old Whitestone, even their registration information was fake.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: They didn't own the name. Why couldn't I use it?
Bai Yi's lips twitch unnaturally, and then twist into a grin that hardly looks like one.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Take a look at this.
Bai Yi raises her hand.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: Take a look at what?
Bai Yi's raised hand balls into a fist.
Thud!
The fist connects with Mr. Bai's face. His giant body, along with the chair, falls onto the floor, and he passes out again.
You come forward, and put the duct tape back on the unconscious man's mouth.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Phew...
Bai Yi has let off some steam.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Alright, let's go save Che and K.K..
Do you have a plan? The guards in the building saw me last time. I won't be able to move around in the building freely.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Let me think...
Bai Yi looks around and sees a cleaning cart in a corner of the office.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Got it!
Bai Yi murmurs as she pushes the cleaning cart along at a brisk pace. You're hiding behind the curtain that hangs down along the side of the cart.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Thank goodness you're small-boned. A bigger person might've had a hard time fitting in.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: One more thing. When we get there, don't come out until I've taken care of all the guards. Then the four of us make a dash for the exit.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: This time, with me on board, we're definitely going to make it out.
Yeah, I've contacted the response team. As soon as we exit the building, they'll come and help us.
Turn right at the end of the hallway, and you'll see the reception room.
Following your instructions, Bai Yi trots on pushing the squeaky cart. Soon enough, you arrive at the reception room.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Stop.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Never seen you before. New here?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Uh, yes, I am.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Why are you still cleaning?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Mr. Bai asked me to...

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Why bother? Whitestone will soon be no more.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Whatever. You're new here; I don't want to make it difficult for you... Just go ahead.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Oh.
Bang!
You hear a loud noise and poke your head out from behind the curtain. The guard is lying on the floor, passed out.
What did you do?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: He said Whitestone was doomed; it got my goat, so...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Correction—this is part of the plan. Now we have one less enemy to deal with when we escape.
...Do something about him. We don't want to blow our cover.
You have no time to argue with her. The two of you lift the unconscious guard, dump him in a trash can, and return to where the door to the reception room is.
You can hear noise coming through the door.

steps.speaker: Guard A
steps.content: Full house! I won!

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Ah, I thought I had it in the bag with two pairs.

steps.speaker: Guard A
steps.content: You've got a lot to learn, bro... But you're a decent card player, I have to say. If you weren't a cop, we'd probably become card-playing buddies.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Oh my, I told you I'm not a cop. They forced me to work for them...

steps.speaker: Guard A
steps.content: Either way, I'm gonna quit after I get my paycheck for this week. If you're not a cop, then you are very welcome to play cards with me in the future.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: All righty... I'm gonna win my money back next time.
It doesn't look like they are in any danger...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: That's just the kind of person he is. He fits in wherever he goes...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Wait a second. What did they just say? They are wrapping it up?
If that's true, now might not be the right time to attack.
We'd better wait and see. I'll ask the response team to stay put.
You take out the terminal, intending to inform the response team using the instant messaging app. But as you do so, you accidentally tap on another icon...

steps.speaker: Ads
steps.content: Crossing over the Rust, 100 Thousand Discoins Each, Ready to Go!
Your heart jumps when the tagline, accompanied by the lousy, cheesy Syndicate-style music, hits your ears.
Undoubtedly, that's the rogue app that Bai Yi tricked you into downloading yesterday.

steps.speaker: Guard A
steps.content: Who's there?! Jason! Jason?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: What's going on with you?
You're asking me?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: God, you don't delete sketchy apps after you download them?
You didn't delete it, because you thought it might provide some useful information. But that's not something you want to tell her.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: ...Never mind. It's too late now. Let's take them down!

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Ha!
Bang—
Bai Yi kicks open the door and swiftly knocks down the two guards close by with her saber.
There are a dozen of people in the room, Che and K.K. among them. They are stupefied for a moment, lost for words as they stare at Bai Yi.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: What are you waiting for? Come on!

Che, who is sitting not far away from you, snaps out of the stupor and punches the face of the distracted guard who has just invited him for future card games. He then snatches the weapon from the guard's hands.
In the meantime, you hurry over to the corner where K.K. is and untie her.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Thank you...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Save the pleasantries. Run!
The four of you waste no time, running out of the room and dashing down to the ground floor.
To your surprise, the escape goes without a glitch. You encounter little resistance, and you are soon out of the gate.
K.K. smashes the glass of a van parked on the roadside. Che slips inside, and hot-wires it.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I'll drive!
Bai Yi sits behind the wheel. The engine roars to life; the van shudders before speeding out of the parking lot outside the building.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Ha, that's too easy. How you got caught by those guys is beyond me. Very humiliating for you.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...They had no intention of stopping us.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Their boss is planning on skipping town. You think they'd risk their necks to stop us?
Anyway, we've escaped. That's all that matters.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: You're right. How about a celebration tonight?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: I don't see why not.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: You two shut up.
Bai Yi has the grace to look embarrassed.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Okay, okay, no celebration tonight, no need to get angry...
